title: Require Closed Service Spine Topology
forbids: a service package, public source root, service spine, module, capability directory, model kind, or proof category outside the closed generic service topology
why: Every service is one constructible package with a required contract-first spine and finite optional interiors. Closing each container prevents host adapters, provider construction, runtime surfaces, product controllers, loose helpers, and source-owned proof from becoming accidental service authority.
remediate: Keep package metadata and finite build or proof files at services/<service>; expose only client.ts, contract.ts, index.ts, and service under src; keep the base, context, contract, implementation, router, schema, and modules spine under src/service; use closed contract, router, middleware, model, and test-category interiors; relocate host and product concerns to their qualified owners.
message: Service packages must match the closed generic service spine and proof topology.
